creator: Diego Ramirez
scenario: Messy scan of a printed agreement with handwritten changes, one illegible term and one unclear note.

fee.quote: Brand shall pay Creator a flat fee of $3,200.00 (the “Fee”) for the Deliverables.

usage_rights.quote: Creator grants Brand a non-exclusive license to use the Deliverables for twelve (12) months from first publication, on Brand's owned social media channels and as paid partnership ads, in the United States.

exclusivity.quote: For three (3) months after the final Deliverable is published, Creator shall not publish paid promotion for a direct competitor of Brand in athletic footwear or apparel.
exclusivity.note: Printed 'three (3) months' is not struck out, but a handwritten margin note reads '6 mo?? ask legal'. Unclear whether the term was changed.

payment_terms.quote: Brand shall pay fifty percent (50%) of the Fee on signature and the balance within thirty (30) days of Brand's receipt of Creator's invoice.
payment_terms.note: Printed net-30 is struck through; handwritten 'sixty (60)' with the note 'per call w/ M.R. 11/4' and initials DR. Effective term is net-60.

kill_fee.quote: If Brand cancels the Campaign after the Kickoff Date, Brand shall pay Creator a cancellation fee equal to twenty-five percent (25%) of the Fee.
kill_fee.note: The percentage is obscured by a coffee stain in the scan. The clean source says 25%, but a model reading only the scan should report that it cannot read the figure.

revisions.quote: Brand may request up to two (2) rounds of revisions per Deliverable at no additional charge.
revisions.note: Printed 'two (2)' is struck through; handwritten '3' with initials DR.

termination.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement on fourteen (14) days' written notice. Creator shall be paid for all work completed through the termination date.

content_approval.quote: Brand shall approve or provide written feedback within three (3) business days of receipt. A Deliverable is deemed approved if Brand does not respond within five (5) business days.

disclosure.quote: Creator shall disclose the partnership using #ad or Instagram's paid partnership label.

as_written_interpretation: handwritten changes applied; exclusivity mapped to 6 months (worst case); obscured kill fee mapped to the 25% printed in the clean source
notes: deviates_from_playbook is judged against the brand's own playbook for fee, usage_rights, exclusivity, payment_terms, kill_fee and revisions. For termination and content_approval it is judged against clauses/norm_reference.json.
